code.title: Item code
code.description: Unique code to identify the item.

state.title: State
state.description: The current state of the item.

name.title: Name
name.description: This name describes your item and will appear on the invoice when it's purchased on a one time basis.

external_sku.title: External SKU
external_sku.description: Optional, stock keeping unit to link the item to other inventory systems.

accounting_code.title: Item accounting code
accounting_code.description: Accounting code for invoice line items.

performance_obligation_id.title: Performance Obligation ID
performance_obligation_id.description:
The ID of a performance obligation. Performance obligations are
only accessible as a part of the Recurly RevRec Standard and
Recurly RevRec Advanced features.

liability_gl_account_id.title: General Ledger Account ID
liability_gl_account_id.description:
The ID of a general ledger account. General ledger accounts are
only accessible as a part of the Recurly RevRec Standard and
Recurly RevRec Advanced features.

revenue_gl_account_id.title: General Ledger Account ID
revenue_gl_account_id.description:
The ID of a general ledger account. General ledger accounts are
only accessible as a part of the Recurly RevRec Standard and
Recurly RevRec Advanced features.

avalara_transaction_type.title: Avalara Transaction Type
avalara_transaction_type.description: Used by Avalara for Communications taxes. The transaction type in combination with the service type describe how the item is taxed. Refer to [the documentation](https://help.avalara.com/AvaTax_for_Communications/Tax_Calculation/AvaTax_for_Communications_Tax_Engine/Mapping_Resources/TM_00115_AFC_Modules_Corresponding_Transaction_Types) for more available t/s types.

avalara_service_type.title: Avalara Service Type
avalara_service_type.description: Used by Avalara for Communications taxes. The transaction type in combination with the service type describe how the item is taxed. Refer to [the documentation](https://help.avalara.com/AvaTax_for_Communications/Tax_Calculation/AvaTax_for_Communications_Tax_Engine/Mapping_Resources/TM_00115_AFC_Modules_Corresponding_Transaction_Types) for more available t/s types.

tax_code.title: Tax code
tax_code.description: Optional field used by Avalara, Vertex, and Recurly's In-the-Box tax solution to determine taxation rules. You can pass in specific tax codes using any of these tax integrations. For Recurly's In-the-Box tax offering you can also choose to instead use simple values of `unknown`, `physical`, or `digital` tax codes.

harmonized_system_code.title: Harmonized System code
harmonized_system_code.description: The Harmonized System (HS) code is an internationally standardized system of names and numbers to classify traded products. The HS code, sometimes called Commodity Code, is used by customs authorities around the world to identify products when assessing duties and taxes. The HS code may also be referred to as the tariff code or customs code. Values should contain only digits and decimals.

tax_exempt.title: Tax exempt?
tax_exempt.description: `true` exempts tax on the item, `false` applies tax on the item.

name.title: Field name
name.description: Fields must be created in the UI before values can be assigned to them.

value.title: Field value
value.description: Any values that resemble a credit card number or security code (CVV/CVC) will be rejected.

source_record_type.title: Source record type
source_record_type.description: The type of record a custom field was automatically copied from.

source_record_id.title: Source record ID
source_record_id.description: The UUID of the record this custom field was automatically copied from. Only present when the field was copied from another record.

custom_fields.title: Custom fields
custom_fields.description: The custom fields will only be altered when they are included in a request. Sending an empty array will not remove any existing values. To remove a field send the name with a null or empty value.

tax_inclusive.title: Tax Inclusive?
tax_inclusive.description: This field is deprecated. Please do not use it.
